description: This file is a PHP source code for configuring the Attendance menu within the OrangeHRM system. It defines the class 'AttendanceMenuConfigurator' which implements menu configuration for the attendance module, overriding the current module to 'time'.

classes.name: AttendanceMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements the MenuConfigurator interface to configure attendance-related menu items and override modules in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to set the current module to 'time' using a helper function, returning null.
